## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only staging and unhealthy).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. (The first attempt timed out, but the incident was confirmed created and is open.)
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried. The second attempt completed successfully.

**Final state (verified):**
- All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**
- Service is **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002

The incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
